aim.en: You can judge a real building against all seven principles and defend each verdict with a photograph, a sketch or a measurement.
aim.sr: Umeš da oceniš stvarnu zgradu po svih sedam principa i da svaku ocenu odbraniš fotografijom, skicom ili merom.

bring.en: A tape measure, a phone, and the building you chose last week.
bring.sr: Metar, telefon i zgrada koju si izabrao prošle nedelje.

text.en: A verdict without evidence is a brochure

This session is a draft. The structure is fixed: each principle gets one piece of evidence and one verdict — met, partly met, failed. At least two principles must fail; if nothing failed, you reviewed the brochure and not the building.
text.sr: Ovaj čas je nacrt. Struktura je određena: svaki princip dobija jedan dokaz i jednu ocenu — ispunjen, delimično, pao. Bar dva principa moraju da padnu; ako ništa nije palo, ocenio si prospekt, a ne zgradu.

items.en: Which principle was hardest to judge, and what would you have had to measure to be sure?
items.sr: Koji princip je bio najteži za ocenu i šta bi morao da izmeriš da budeš siguran?
